notes.title: PROPHET - a MICRO-HORROR GAME by CatTrigger
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h1][b]A NEW GAME IS HERE[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774152/6c1d8d242671c4125ad1473c45d9095abd3963e0.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi, it's CatTrigger.

Some of you may have already been notified, since you follow me on itch.io... and I apologize not sending this newsletter out earlier...as I was catching up on some sleep after the O2A2 game jam.

That's right, I made another short game for the O2A2 game jam called [url="https://cattrigger.itch.io/prophet"]PROPHET[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][i]Your village has chosen [b]YOU[/b] for this pilgrimage, where you will ascend to Heaven representing them.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Near the end of your travels, you come upon the Great Prophet of the Church.  She will assist you on the ritual...[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]...but the Prophet may not be who she says she is.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Prophet is a Horror Micro-Game made for the O2A2 Micro-Game Jam that is part Visual Novel & Part Point 'n' Click.[/p][p]You are a Pilgrim nearing to the end of your Pilgrimage, committed to the final steps of the ritual with the Great Prophet.  Your choices will judge what happens to you and the future of the church.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]As with all O2A2 games, this game was created under strict guidelines:[/p][p]- Only one character "sprite model" visually featured.[/p][p]- Only one environment[/p][p]- Only one soundtrack.[/p][p]- Only one sound effect.[/p][p]- 1,000 words or less, excluding repeats (Game is exactly 1000 words).  [/p][p]- Only 10 days from START to COMPLETION.[/p][p]I've participated in O2A2 for the last 4 years.  PROPHET has been the most ambitious entry for this jam for me.  I hope you enjoy it :).[/p][p][/p][h1][url="https://cattrigger.itch.io/prophet"]Play it here for free[/url][/h1]
